verdict.rationale: Orrick Tech Studio is a free, no-registration public resource. Its launch announcement cites 300+ articles, videos and podcasts plus FAQ and glossary databases. The resources pages offer a jargon glossary and Q&A-style answers, and the stages pages cover building a company's foundation, alongside a Series A fundraising tool. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the articles and FAQs themselves (community comments mostly praise the document templates), and explicit evidence of plain-language explainers on equity specifically.
